title: resolution of every finding in receipts/card-consistency-audit.json, with the receipt each corrected value was read from

method.grounding: every corrected value was read from the named authoritative receipt in this repository, not from the audit's transcription of it; where the audit quoted a figure, the receipt was opened and the field located before the card was touched
method.line_numbers: the audit's line numbers had drifted, because all four cards had been edited by other agents after the audit ran, so every site was located by content match rather than by line number
method.figure_alt_text: assets/fidelity-vs-size-light.svg is matplotlib path-rendered and carries no extractable text nodes, so its labels were read from its generator tools/make_charts.py, which is authoritative for every string, value and line in the figure
method.blank_lines: every run of two or more consecutive blank lines outside fenced code blocks was collapsed to one, in all four cards
method.publication: each card was uploaded as README.md together with a refreshed DOCS-SHA256SUMS in the same commit, then re-fetched and compared byte for byte against the local file

additional_changes_beyond_the_audit.what: the 37.4 KB/token and 33.5 KB/token KV rates in MODEL_CARD-K5K6-hydrated.md and MODEL_CARD-K5K6.md were printed as if they were extrapolation coefficients
additional_changes_beyond_the_audit.why: TwentyFourGigProxy and SixteenGigVerdict established from the pinned image's own vllm/v1/core/kv_cache_utils.py that 'GPU KV cache size: N tokens' is int(max_concurrency * max_model_len), so the pool one request needs is affine in the window rather than a flat per-token cost; the tell was that neither published KV token count is a multiple of the attention block size
additional_changes_beyond_the_audit.before: 'The engine needs 9.13 GiB of KV (37.4 KB/token ...). Without MTP that falls to 33.5 KB/token and buys ~11 % more length.' and 'KV costs 37.4 KB/token with MTP-3 ... and 33.5 KB/token without it'
additional_changes_beyond_the_audit.after: both sites now add: the KB/token figures are ratios measured at that one window, not coefficients to extrapolate other windows with, because the KV pool one request needs is affine in the window (a per-token term plus a fixed per-request term), so dividing a KV budget by a KB/token figure does not predict a context length
additional_changes_beyond_the_audit.deliberately_not_done: no card restates the new bounded per-class window predictions; those belong to docs/34 and TwentyFourGigProxy, and one of them is now a bounded range rather than a point
additional_changes_beyond_the_audit.measured_kv_facts_unchanged: 9.28 GiB = 265,122 tokens at the qualified profile, 1.01x concurrency at 262,144, 266,612 / 272,570 / 280,017 / 291,933 / 289,577 and 9.13 / 9.31 GiB are untouched in every card
